name: ebz7-BlackoutAddons
teaser: Turns Vultify's Blackout into a survival event: restart failing generators, fix breakers, repair a burnt control, race a 3-minute emergency-power escape, fight Black Division hunters and a surprise Killa. Unofficial add-on.
description:
Unofficial add-on for [Blackout] by Vultify. It extends the Labs blackout event. Blackout is required.

⚠️ How this was made: I designed, balanced and play-tested this mod; the code was written with the help of an AI assistant, i have a great background in testing software, but no so much with code, im still learning, i hope this is okay. Source code is public (see Source Code Links).

What it adds

⚡ Bring the power back – if you can

  • A generator control switch in the basement generator room. Starting the old generators is hard: they fail to start, generator B trips during sync, and the control can burn out for good (brutal default settings: roughly 1 in 3 raids gets full power).
  • Staged power-up: generators spin up, lights come back wave by wave with flicker, siren and red warning beacons in the generator room.
  • Generator B trips → only half of Labs has power (half the extracts and keycard doors) until you reset the tripped breakers in the switchgear room and restart B.
  • Minutes after full power, the sector B breaker can fail again: auto-reclose keeps trying (lights back for seconds, then out) until you reset the cabinet.
  • Burnt control: the generators try to start by themselves now and then (false starts). The whole facility flickers with the struggling engine for 15–30 s, then dies again.
  • No power = nothing works: keycard readers are dead and there’s no emergency code.

🔧 Repair kit

A burnt control can be repaired with a Toolset, a Spark plug and 2 Bundles of wires. The toolset and wires are hidden in the facility; the spark plug is in a Black Division guard’s pockets (they took it when they cut the power). After the repair the generator starts for sure: 50% full power, 50% only generator A.

🚨 Emergency power – 3 minutes to get out

Wedge carries Blackout’s key. Using it on the gate switch puts Labs on emergency batteries: both gates and the parking door open, red beacons spin in the main rooms and an on-screen countdown starts. After 3 minutes the batteries are flat: the gates close and even the emergency lamps die.

💀 Black Division and Killa

  • Wedge + 4 Black Division guards are the ones who cut the power: they arrive in the generator room, then the lights go out.
  • They hunt – you, PMCs, raiders – and are hostile to everyone. With SAIN + BigBrain they really move instead of camping.
  • Second wave: 3 more come back when you restore power or open the gates.
  • Black Division can carry Labs keycards (25% each).
  • Surprise final boss: once Black Division is wiped out, Killa breaks in through the sewage conduit – banging, screaming, then he stalks you. The sewage conduit opens as an extract when he breaks in.

🔊 Sound

Own generator, breaker, false-start and PA sounds; the game’s own Labs announcer lines are played from your game files.

Requirements

  • SPT 4.1.x
  • Blackout (Vultify) – client + server
  • WTT Black Division (+ its requirements: MoreBotsAPI, BigBrain)
  • Recommended: SAIN (Black Division hunts through SAIN)

Install

Extract the zip into your SPT folder:

  • BepInEx/plugins/BlackoutPowerRestore/ (client)
  • user/mods/BlackoutBlackDivision/ (server)

Configuration

  • Client: F12 configuration manager → “Blackout Power Restore” (difficulty, timers, Black Division, Killa, sounds…).
  • Server: user/mods/BlackoutBlackDivision/config.jsonc (Wedge, guards, keycards, Killa).
  • Placement keys (optional): Ctrl+F7 breaker cabinet, Ctrl+F2 repair-part spot, Ctrl+F3 emergency beacon, Ctrl+F5 shows where Killa / Black Division / parts are.

Credits

  • Blackout – Vultify (required; this is an unofficial add-on)
  • WTT Black Division, MoreBotsAPI, BigBrain (DrakiaXYZ), SAIN (Solarint) – their authors
  • Not affiliated with Battlestate Games, SPT or any of the authors above.
